name: NOVA / ChatGPT Studio Explainer
purpose: Recreate the polished Tumsoev + Liza AI-studio explainer/presentation look from the reference video.
triggerPhrases: Сделай в стиле NOVA Studio Explainer
Сделай как то видео с Лизой и инфографикой

masterTarget.note: The uploaded file is a portrait screen recording; the actual designed video is a horizontal 16:9 panel centered inside it. Do not bake the black screen-recording bars into the master unless explicitly requested.

visualSystem.overallStyle: premium dark technology presentation / motion-graphics explainer
visualSystem.background: very dark navy-to-black, subtle grid/technical lines, restrained glow
visualSystem.text: clean bold white sans-serif headings; smaller cool-gray supporting text
visualSystem.layout: persistent presenter on left; headline and narrative in center; animated media/diagram/card panel on right; top brand strip; small footer/status captions
visualSystem.branding: Tumsoev mark/top-left, technical section labels, compact interface labels; no random external logos or watermarks

presenter.name: Liza
presenter.placement: left side, approximately one-third of the visual width
presenter.look: blue-gray hair, bright cyan/blue eyes, dark navy outfit with LIZA name tag
presenter.continuity: same face, hair, outfit, proportions and placement across all scenes

sceneDesign.structure: about 10-14 short visual chapters across a one-minute explainer
sceneDesign.camera: mostly locked 2D composition; no unnecessary cinematic pans, shakes or dramatic zooms

motionLanguage.easing: smooth ease-out / cubic, no bouncy cartoon easing
motionLanguage.readabilityRule: motion supports comprehension; never animate every element at once

typography.headline: bold geometric/system sans, high contrast, 2-4 short lines maximum
typography.labels: small uppercase technical labels with increased tracking
typography.captions: small lower caption/status line when useful

audio.music: optional subtle electronic/ambient bed only after speech is clear
audio.sfx: soft interface ticks/whooshes only where they support a transition
audio.rule: never let music or SFX cover speech

productionRecipe: 1. Write a concise Russian script and split it into 4-6 second chapters.
2. Build one reusable 16:9 master layout with fixed Liza presenter, brand bar and dark tech background.
3. Give each chapter one main visual idea only: card, diagram, waveform, metric, robot, app list, or photo.
4. Animate with restrained slide/fade/scale/line-draw motions and smooth cubic easing.
5. Keep Liza continuous; use blink/mouth/hand micro-animation rather than regenerating her every scene.
6. Add narration; align captions/graphic beats to spoken phrases.
7. Add subtle ambience/SFX only after voice timing is approved.
8. Export one clean 16:9 MP4 master; create 9:16 adaptation separately if requested.
negativeRules: no photorealistic presenter unless explicitly requested
no changing Liza identity between scenes
no black screen-recording bars in the clean master
no paid generation or automatic paid retry without explicit permission

defaultDelivery.note: Use deterministic motion graphics first because this reference is primarily a designed explainer, not a photorealistic text-to-video shot.

assistantCommandMeaning: When Tumsoev says one of the trigger phrases, use this preset as the default look and workflow, then adapt only the script/topic/media while preserving the presenter, layout language, pacing, transitions and dark cyan technical branding.
